q.en: Is the film a continuation of the series?

a.en: Yes. The film continues the story of the court and its people. It is written so that newcomers can follow it too.
a.am: አዎ። ፊልሙ የችሎቱን እና የሰዎቹን ታሪክ ይቀጥላል። አዲስ ተመልካቾችም እንዲከተሉት ተደርጎ ተጽፏል።

a.en: The target release window is shown on the home page countdown. Confirmed dates will be announced in the Production Diary.
a.am: የታቀደው የምርቃት ጊዜ በመነሻ ገጹ ላይ ተገልጿል። የተረጋገጡ ቀናት በቀረጻ ማስታወሻው ይገለጻሉ።

q.en: Can I watch the series here?

a.en: Yes — the Series page streams available episodes, organised by season. Episodes are hosted on the official GERA KEGN YouTube channel.
a.am: አዎ — የተከታታዩ ገጽ ያሉትን ክፍሎች በምዕራፍ ተደራጅተው ያሳያል። ክፍሎቹ በይፋዊው የግራ ቀኝ የዩቲዩብ ቻናል ላይ ይገኛሉ።

a.en: Yes, available episodes are free to watch. Availability may vary by country depending on rights.
a.am: አዎ፣ ያሉት ክፍሎች በነጻ ይታያሉ። እንደ መብቱ በአንዳንድ አገሮች ሊለያይ ይችላል።

q.en: What does it mean to become a producer?

a.en: Producers are supporters who contribute to the making of the film and receive the recognition and rewards of their chosen level. It is a reward-based contribution, not an investment or ownership stake.
a.am: ፕሮዲዩሰሮች ለፊልሙ ሥራ አስተዋጽኦ የሚያደርጉ እና በመረጡት ደረጃ ዕውቅና እና ሽልማት የሚያገኙ ደጋፊዎች ናቸው። ይህ የሽልማት መሠረት ያለው አስተዋጽኦ እንጂ ኢንቨስትመንት ወይም የባለቤትነት ድርሻ አይደለም።

q.en: What happens if the goal isn't reached?

a.en: This will be set out in the campaign terms before launch. [To be confirmed by the production.]
a.am: ይህ ዘመቻው ከመጀመሩ በፊት በውሉ ይገለጻል። [በፕሮዳክሽኑ የሚረጋገጥ]

a.en: ጓድ (guad, “comrade”) Producers are backers who contribute at the qualifying level. Their names appear in the film's dedicated ጓድ Producer credit roll.
a.am: ጓድ ፕሮዲዩሰሮች በብቁ ደረጃ የሚያዋጡ ደጋፊዎች ናቸው። ስማቸው በፊልሙ የጓድ ፕሮዲዩሰሮች ዝርዝር ውስጥ ይወጣል።

q.en: How do I submit my name for the credits?

a.en: After your qualifying contribution, use the name submission form on the ጓድ Producer page before the credit deadline.
a.am: ብቁ አስተዋጽኦ ካደረጉ በኋላ፣ ከመጨረሻው ቀን በፊት በጓድ ፕሮዲዩሰር ገጽ ላይ ያለውን ቅጽ ይጠቀሙ።

q.en: How can my company partner with the film?

a.en: See the Corporate Partners page for packages and send an enquiry. The partnerships team will reply with a full proposal.
a.am: ለጥቅሎቹ የድርጅት አጋሮች ገጽን ይመልከቱ እና ጥያቄ ይላኩ። የአጋርነት ቡድኑ ሙሉ ፕሮፖዛል ይልካል።

a.en: Yes. International cards and PayPal are supported in USD, EUR and GBP.
a.am: አዎ። ዓለም አቀፍ ካርዶች እና PayPal በUSD፣ EUR እና GBP ይቀበላሉ።

q.en: Will the film screen in my city?

a.en: Vote for your city on the Diaspora page. Cities with the most supporters are prioritised for screenings.
a.am: በዲያስፖራ ገጽ ላይ ለከተማዎ ድምጽ ይስጡ። ብዙ ደጋፊ ያላቸው ከተሞች ቅድሚያ ያገኛሉ።

a.en: telebirr, CBE Birr and Chapa in Ethiopia; international cards and PayPal abroad. Payments are processed by the provider — card details never touch this website.
a.am: በኢትዮጵያ telebirr፣ CBE Birr እና Chapa፤ በውጭ ዓለም አቀፍ ካርዶች እና PayPal። ክፍያዎች በአቅራቢው ይስተናገዳሉ — የካርድ መረጃ በዚህ ድረ ገጽ አያልፍም።

q.en: How will I know how the money is used?

a.en: The Transparency page shows the funding goal, progress, use of funds and milestones, and is updated throughout production.
a.am: የግልጽነት ገጹ ግቡን፣ ሂደቱን፣ የገንዘብ አጠቃቀሙን እና ምዕራፎችን ያሳያል፤ በቀረጻው ሁሉ ይዘመናል።

a.en: Ticketing will open closer to release. Join the newsletter to get first access.
a.am: የትኬት ሽያጭ ወደ ምርቃቱ ሲቃረብ ይከፈታል። ቅድሚያ ለማግኘት ይመዝገቡ።
